sections.title: The Pastures
sections.aim: Bring the flock into the fold before dark.
sections.why: They are his father's sheep, not his own. A shepherd answers for every one of them.

sections.title: The Well
sections.aim: Water the flock at the well, and count them in.
sections.why: Sheep not watered at evening will not last the next day's heat. And the count is how a shepherd learns that one is gone.

sections.title: The Lost Lamb
sections.aim: Follow the lamb's trail up the ravine, and keep the jackals off the stray ewe you find on the way.
sections.why: A hired man would call it one lamb in a flock. The flock is his father's, and he will have to answer for it.

sections.title: The Wadi
sections.aim: Follow the tracks up the dry riverbed.
sections.why: The prints beside the lamb's are a great cat's. Every hour makes it less likely the lamb is alive.

sections.title: The Bear's Den
sections.aim: Go through the cave the tracks lead into, and drive out the bear that holds it.
sections.why: There is no way round it. Whatever lives in here, the lamb was carried this way.

sections.title: The Lion's Ridge
sections.aim: Take the lamb back from the lion, and carry it down off the ridge.
sections.why: This is the night he will tell a king about, when no one believes a boy can fight: "I went out after him."

sections.title: The Night Watch
sections.aim: Keep the flock through the night: feed the fire, drive off what comes, and call back any that break out.
sections.why: A flock that has smelt a lion breaks from the fold at a sound. The night is when a shepherd earns his keep.

sections.title: The Anointing
sections.aim: Gather the flock, bring it home, and go where you are sent.
sections.why: He does not know yet that a prophet is waiting in his father's house, or what this day will make of him.

sections.title: The Summons
sections.aim: Hand the flock to a keeper, and bring the loaded donkey to your father.
sections.why: The king has sent for him. But the flock is still his to answer for: he cannot leave until another man can keep it.

sections.title: The Ridge Road
sections.aim: Lead the loaded donkey north along the ridge to Gibeah.
sections.why: What his father sent is the family's word to the king. It has to arrive whole.

sections.title: The Gate of Gibeah
sections.aim: Get in at the barred gate, hand your father's gift to the steward, and wait to be called.
sections.why: A shepherd boy does not walk into a king's hall. Someone has to bring him.
